title: Stock Market Holiday 2026: Are NSE, BSE closed today on account of  Diwali-Balipratipada? Check remaining holidays for the year
summary: The Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange will not operate on November 10 in celebration of Diwali-Balipratipada. However, trading will continue on the Multi-Commodity Exchange that evening. After an initial spike, both indices faced a slight decrease during the recent Muhurat Trading. Notably, the market capitalization has enjoyed a robust increase recently, with further holidays causing closures on November 24 and December 25.

title: Foreign investors keep faith in 83 stocks despite prolonged India selloff
summary: Foreign portfolio investors have favored 83 companies, including LIC, ONGC, and Indian Bank, over the past four quarters. Despite foreign investors selling nearly $28 billion of Indian stocks, some companies saw increased holdings. Large-cap firms like Lupin and SAIL attracted more interest from FPIs during this period. Recent concerns over crude oil prices and inflation impacted the sentiment of foreign investors towards Indian equities.

title: Global brokerages turn bullish on Indian equities as market rebounds
summary: Global brokerages HSBC, Citigroup, and Jefferies have upgraded their outlook on Indian equities. They cite improving earnings prospects and attractive valuations as key factors for this optimism. Recent foreign fund inflows and reduced oil prices further support this positive sentiment. Citigroup anticipates significant growth in the Nifty 50 by the end of 2027. Overall, Indian equities are poised for a sharp recovery in the coming years.

title: India VIX jumps 68% in three weeks despite 7% rally in Sensex, Nifty
summary: India VIX, which measures market volatility, has risen by 68% over the last three weeks. This increase occurred as benchmark indices, like Sensex and Nifty, gained over 7%. Meanwhile, broader market indices, BSE MidCap 150 and BSE SmallCap 250, experienced declines of 3% and 4.6%, respectively. Market experts note that volatility can rise during rapid price increases as well.

title: These large-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of over 25%
summary: The FPIs that were selling in the Indian market all these months mostly owned large-cap stocks. And as they sold them, it was that segment which bore the brunt of the selling. The same logic will operate in reverse as they start buying, focusing once again on the safer and more liquid large-cap stocks.

title: Nifty reclaims 25,000 as bank stocks play catch up
summary: On Monday, market indices Sensex and Nifty showed a recovery following heavy intraday losses. Investors reacted positively to gains in banking stocks driven by foreign purchases and falling crude oil prices. The Sensex closed at 81,106.65, rising 107.25 points, while the Nifty ended at 25,044.65 after gaining 58.25 points. Additionally, the Nifty PSU Bank index surged almost 4%, making it the top-performing sectoral index.

title: Blackstone set to acquire 15% of IIFL for Rs 5,000 crore
summary: Blackstone will invest around Rs 5,000 crore for a 15% stake in IIFL Finance, while promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman will invest Rs 1,200 crore to retain their combined holding at around 25%. Mumbai-based investor Rohit Kothari, through Anchorage Capital, will contribute about Rs 100 crore, taking the total capital infusion to over Rs 6,200 crore.

title: Growing demand, demographics, digital agenda & energy security are long-term and secular tailwinds for India: Macquarie’s Ed Northam
summary: Head of green Investments for the Australia’s largest asset manager said the firm is looking to reboot its India operations. While renewables will remain the biggest focus, industrial energy transition and E-mobility will be other key areas, he said. Since 2005, Green Investments group has deployed over $21 billion across 94 investments worldwide.

title: Satya Micro Capital to sell its housing finance arm to address liquidity crunch
summary: Satya Micro Capital plans to sell its housing finance subsidiary for ₹150-200 crore to ease liquidity pressure and strengthen its financial position. The microfinance lender has shortlisted three buyers and expects to close the deal within a month. The move comes amid mounting debt repayments, weak asset quality and losses.

summary: Banks led by JPMorgan Chase & Co. could offer one of the year’s biggest discounts to sell some of the $5 billion in debt for software firm Qualtrics International Inc. that the underwriters were stuck holding a few months ago.

title: EIB’s Calvino Says US Turmoil Is Driving Capital to Europe
summary: Europe is set to benefit from recent market turmoil in the US as investors seek a safe haven, according to European Investment Bank President Nadia Calvino.

title: Top Yen Forecaster Predicts 147 Per Dollar as Rate Gap Narrows
summary: Neil Parker has spent nearly three decades tracking the yen, through financial crises and sharp currency swings. Now, the top dollar-yen forecaster in Bloomberg’s latest rankings sees the Japanese currency rallying toward 147 per dollar next year as Japan’s interest-rate gap with the US narrows.

title: Viking Loses 1.2% in October After Eschewing Many Big AI Bets
summary: Viking Global Investors’ flagship hedge fund dropped 1.2% last month, faring better than many of its rivals after largely avoiding high-flying artificial-intelligence stocks.

title: Boeing layoffs: Company to cut 5% of commercial airplane workforce as production delays threaten recovery plans
summary: Boeing plans to cut around 5% of its Commercial Airplanes workforce through attrition and layoffs as it struggles to ramp up jetliner production, delays its 737 output targets and pushes back its $10 billion free cash flow goal to 2029.

title: Donald Trump says FBI is investigating Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy as trouble mounts for Nvidia CEO
summary: US President Donald Trump says the FBI is looking into allegations involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a Singapore-based businesswoman suspected of links to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia’s board has launched an inquiry into whether Huang was a target of foreign intelligence.

title: Yes Bank AT-1 bondholders still await clarity on their money nearly a month after SC verdict
summary: Investors are still waiting for Yes Bank to restore their  ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond investments nearly a month after the Supreme Court overturned the 2020 write-off.

title: BNPL makes a comeback as payment apps try to fix its broken economics
summary: The latest proposition combines payments, shopping and credit: acquire customers through UPI, finance their purchases and use repayment behaviour to assess them for larger loans.

title: Pay by the mile! GMR proposes nearly doubling UDF at Bhogapuram airport, drawing IndiGo's ire
summary: Airlines and experts warn that higher fees could make flying less affordable, dampen passenger demand and push short-haul travellers towards trains.

title: Leak, conflict and loss of arbitration: inside a Tata Power Mumbai FIR
summary: Tata Power has accused an arbitrator and former employees of undisclosed ties and leaking confidential data in its dispute with Kleros Capital. The allegations follow a Singapore ruling awarding Kleros $490 million plus interest, and an order to seize shares in two Tata Power arms.
